name: Camp Tracy Day Camp
description_short: Day camp for children in grades K to 9 on a 32 acre site on McGrath Pond in Oakland, run by the Alfond Youth & Community Center. Groups by grade do archery, boating, swimming, the climbing tower, ropes course and zip line, with a theme each week and buses from the center in Waterville.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds requested before June 1 are full; from June 1 until two weeks before the session, full refund less the deposit. Two weeks notice is needed to drop a week, and there are no refunds for partial weeks.
swim_waterfront_notes: Waterfront on McGrath Pond with a boating area for canoes, kayaks and paddle boards.
notes: One week costs $300 for members and non-members alike. Bus from the Alfond Youth & Community Center in Waterville is free for members and $40 a week for non-members. Before care 7 to 8 am and after care 4 to 5:15 pm at camp.
